notes.title: Really, thank you very much.
notes.content:
After a long journey, thanks to you, I can now use the term "developer" for myself. 
Falling Flower has finally sold 100 copies!

It may seem like a small number to some, but to me, it is an invaluable achievement.

Despite the game's lack of visual appeal and its complex explanations, 
I am deeply moved that there are people who sought out new games and gave mine a chance. Truly, thank you so much.

I hope you continue to support DO NOT TOUCH.

I am preparing my next project. I will come back with a richer game next time.
